name: parlayapi-mcp
description: Sports odds, player props, source coverage and analysis tools for AI assistants. Public discovery works without a key; full data uses your own ParlayAPI account.

PARLAYAPI_KEY.description: ParlayAPI API key. Public preview and signup tools work without it.

PARLAY_API_KEY.description: Alias accepted for clients that use underscore-style API key env names.

PARLAYAPI_BASE_URL.description: Override for local development or staging.

tools.name: parlayapi_signup
tools.description: Create a free-tier account and return API key plus claim URL.

tools.name: parlayapi_checkout_link
tools.description: Generate a Stripe upgrade URL for any tier.

tools.name: parlayapi_magic_link
tools.description: Email a passwordless login link.

tools.name: parlayapi_get_pricing
tools.description: Return current public pricing and credit tiers.

tools.name: parlayapi_live_sports
tools.description: List active live sports, event counts, and book counts.

tools.name: parlayapi_live_search
tools.description: Search live teams, players, and sport keys.

tools.name: parlayapi_live_command_center
tools.description: Public best-line preview from the /live dashboard.

tools.name: parlayapi_source_quality
tools.description: Public source freshness and quality metadata.

tools.name: parlayapi_book_coverage
tools.description: Public per-book five-gate coverage proof.

tools.name: parlayapi_list_sports
tools.description: List supported sport keys.

tools.name: parlayapi_get_odds
tools.description: Game-level odds across configured books.

tools.name: parlayapi_get_props
tools.description: Player prop odds with optional filters.

tools.name: parlayapi_best_line
tools.description: Best price per outcome across books.

tools.name: parlayapi_find_arbitrage
tools.description: Find cross-book arbitrage candidates.

tools.name: parlayapi_find_ev
tools.description: Find positive-EV bets vs a sharp book's no-vig fair line.

tools.name: parlayapi_consensus
tools.description: Consensus (average) odds across all bookmakers per market.

tools.name: parlayapi_find_middles
tools.description: Find cross-book middle opportunities.

tools.name: parlayapi_verdict
tools.description: One-call 'should I bet this?': no-vig fair price vs the market, best book (scoped to books you can bet at), and a plain-English BET/LEAN/FAIR/PASS call.

tools.name: parlayapi_set_bettable_books
tools.description: Remember which books/region the user can bet at, so verdict recommendations skip books they can't use.

tools.name: parlayapi_parlay_verdict
tools.description: Grade a multi-leg parlay: combined fair price, best single book to place it, EV, weakest leg, same-game correlation warnings, payout.

tools.name: parlayapi_best_bets
tools.description: What should I bet now? Ranked +EV plays for a sport, scoped to books you can bet at, plus edge alerts.

tools.name: parlayapi_account_info
tools.description: Tier, credits remaining, and billing period.

security_posture.permissions: Network-only stdio MCP server. No filesystem access and no local credential discovery.
security_posture.auth_model: Public preview tools are keyless. Paid data tools require an explicit ParlayAPI key in env.
